tools.name: get_published_buy_calls
tools.description: Use this when the user asks where to read AlphaYou published US stock buy calls. Returns the link to the public calls page only. It does not return prices, targets, thesis, rankings or ticker-specific details.

tools.name: get_public_calls_record
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how AlphaYou published calls performed, including losses or comparison with SPY. Returns the canonical complete public calls scorecard link. Numerical results, methodology and disclosures are on that page and are not returned by this tool.

tools.name: search_hyperliquid_traders
tools.description: Use for a historical score or Sharpe ranking of the qualified trader cohort. Returns at most ten rows per page, with next_offset when more are available. Accepts an optional exact asset and leverage-tier filter. Not a market-wide ranking, 30-day PnL sort or personalized recommendation.

tools.name: analyze_hyperliquid_wallet
tools.description: Use for historical performance and risk of a supplied public Hyperliquid address. Cached metrics and available history only, not live positions or owner identity.

tools.name: get_hyperliquid_wallet_positions
tools.description: Use for positions of one public Hyperliquid wallet on one perpetual venue. Accepts an optional asset for named markets such as Nvidia, which the service resolves to its venue; the venue defaults to native only. An empty native result does not establish absence across all venues.

tools.name: compare_hyperliquid_traders
tools.description: Use one call to compare two to five distinct public wallets. Returns the analysis time, history length, losses and missing results of each wallet as reported. No suitability or follower-return claims.

tools.name: get_hyperliquid_activity
tools.description: Use for observed position changes over one to 168 hours in the watcher cohort. Returns one oldest-first page, with since and next_cursor for continuation. The default minimum position notional is $1 million; pass 0 for all or smaller positions. Minimum notional is position size, not incremental trad

tools.name: get_hyperliquid_positioning
tools.description: Use for long/short notionals and counts in the qualified cohort for an exact case-sensitive asset, such as BTC or xyz:NVDA. Newest row update is not whole-cohort freshness. Not total exchange positioning or a price prediction.

tools.name: get_hyperliquid_wallets_positions
tools.description: Use for positions of two to five wallets in one batch call, for example after a ranking. Covers one venue with bounded upstream concurrency and reports individual wallet failures. Accepts an optional asset for named markets.

tools.name: resolve_hyperliquid_market
tools.description: Use to resolve Nvidia, NVDA, Bitcoin, ETH or an explicit venue symbol against Hyperliquid metadata. Returns alternatives, ambiguity and coverage. A perpetual contract is not the underlying stock.

tools.name: get_hyperliquid_market_state
tools.description: Use for a Hyperliquid market mark price, 24-hour change, funding, open interest and volume. This is exchange context, not a US stock quote. Returns the retrieval time; the exchange observation time is unknown. Not a prediction.

tools.name: get_alphayou_capabilities
tools.description: Use for requests to start copy trading or subscribe to alerts. Returns that this connector supports research only. It does not connect wallets, fund, sign, place orders, start copying, or create alerts or scheduled tasks.

tools.name: get_financial_quality
